meta.note: Scripted speaking/conversation practice. Everything is class-axis gated: dialogues reference curriculum ids (wd-/ch-) and a unit; the tab shows them only when JY_CONTENT.isTaught(unit) is true, never fabricating a gloss or pinyin. Phrase text is composed at runtime from the tokens' own hanzi; phrase pinyin is the join of each token's pinyin from content.json. 'en' is a short communicative label for the UI (what the line DOES), not a claimed book translation. Pronunciation sets are phonetics (Licao 0, taught); hanzi/gloss shown only where a taught, glossed character exists.

pronunciation.title: The four tones
pronunciation.en: Hear and copy the four tone contours. Same syllable, four meanings.
pronunciation.note: 妈 mā and 马 mǎ are taught characters (Lição 0 汉字). The 2nd and 4th tones here are shown as sound only — Básico 1 glosses no character for them, so none is invented.

pronunciation.title: Initials 声母
pronunciation.en: Repeat each initial after the model. These are sounds, not words.
pronunciation.note: 23 initials including y and w, exactly as her Lição 0 fonética deck lists them. The full table with the book's pictures lives in Content; the real recordings are in Audio.

pronunciation.title: Finals 韵母
pronunciation.en: Repeat each final after the model.
pronunciation.note: A representative set from the Lição 0 韵母 table; see Content for the full table and Audio for the recordings.

readAloud.title: Say the character
readAloud.en: A taught character appears — say its reading aloud, then hear the model and rate yourself.
readAloud.note: Pulled live from JY_CONTENT.taughtChars() filtered to cardable — so it always holds exactly the characters your class has reached, and never one without a reading.

dialogues.title: Saying hello
dialogues.en: The first exchange of every class: greet, and greet back.

turns.prompt: The teacher said 你好. Say hello back.
turns.hint: 好 hǎo is the character you already know. Put 你 nǐ (or polite 您 nín) in front.

dialogues.title: Asking a name
dialogues.en: The Lição 1 Texto 1 exchange: give your surname, then your full name.

turns.hint: 姓 xìng = apelido (sobrenome). Say 我姓 then your family name.
我 wǒ = eu, 叫 jiào = chamar. Say 我叫 then your own name.

dialogues.title: Where are you from
dialogues.en: Say your nationality. (Later in Lição 1 — country words aren't taught yet.)

turns.hint: 是 shì = ser. 巴西 Bāxī = Brasil, then 人 rén = pessoa.
认识 rènshi = conhecer, 很 hěn = muito, 高兴 gāoxìng = contente.
